decision: dropped features rows after last training date 2012-10-26
rationale: Those rows belong to Kaggle's hidden test period; they contain NaN CPI/Unemployment and no sales.

decision: filled with 0 and added indicator `markdown_available` (1 from 2011-11-11)
rationale: Structural missingness: markdowns were not recorded before the programme. Median-filling (as in the reference notebook) would invent promotions. The indicator lets models distinguish 'no markdown' from 'not recorded'.
Negative promotional spend is not meaningful.

decision: forward-filled within store (past-only); none remain inside the training window
rationale: No global median/mean imputation, which would leak future/global statistics.

decision: train LEFT JOIN stores ON Store; LEFT JOIN features ON (Store, Date); IsHoliday taken from train (verified identical to features.IsHoliday)

rationale: Returns/adjustments are genuine records; WAPE/MAE/RMSE are computed on signed values.

decision: NOT removed; investigated in EDA (see docs/eda.md)
rationale: The reference notebook dropped |z|>2.5 rows, which deletes exactly the holiday peaks inventory planning needs.

decision: no global normalisation of Weekly_Sales; models forecast dollars
rationale: Inside LightGBM the target is divided by a past-only per-series scale and multiplied back (invertible, dollars out).

decision: series x week grid 3331 x 143; unobserved cells kept as NaN (not zero) for features/evaluation; treated as 0 only when summing to aggregates
rationale: 11.5% of cells are unobserved (series start late, end early or have gaps).

decision: hierarchy group level = Type (state proxy; no state in Walmart files)
rationale: stores.csv has no state/region. Supply config/store_state_mapping.csv (Store,State) to use real states; no mapping is invented.
